name: Family & Consumer Sciences
namee: Ciencias de la Familia y el Consumidor
fwnote: FCS codes are NASAFACS area-of-study content standards (FCS 8.2 = food safety and sanitation procedures), which are not grade-banded; K-5 units add Illinois Goal 22 health benchmarks (1 = early, 2 = late elementary) and Common Core math as adopted by Illinois. Alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification.

1.bq: How do clean hands keep me and my friends healthy?
std: FCS 8.2
Practice basic sanitation procedures, beginning with proper hand washing.
FCS 14.4
Recognize how clean hands and surfaces help keep food safe to eat.
IL 22.A.1b
Identify ways to promote health and prevent illness, such as hand washing and cleanliness.
